mechanisms.title: Undersized Annulus Below 23 mm Minimum Design Coverage
mechanisms.explanation: The design req10-valve-b only provides nominal sizes 25, 27, and 29, which cover an annulus range of 23 mm to 29 mm. Of the 136 development hearts with no fit (all failing the annulus-coverage rule), 115 hearts have an annulus smaller than the 23 mm minimum limit: 6 hearts are in the 18-20 mm band, 62 hearts are in the 20-22 mm band, and 47 no-fit hearts are in the 22-24 mm band. Overall, the 136 annulus-coverage failure hearts have a lower mean annulusMm of 22.8971468150301 mm (compared to 25.5258090940402 mm in the rest of the cohort, effectSize -1.06284793684339), alongside smaller mean lvotMm (22.0912620082774 mm vs 25.2947071535974 mm), sinusMm (30.803038431824 mm vs 33.870931603642 mm), and sinotubularJunctionMm (28.0735707409662 mm vs 30.3363771832067 mm). For example, heart-006 has an annulusMm of 21.6659799625308 mm, failing the 23 mm lower limit with a margin of -1.33402003746923 mm.

mechanisms.title: Oversized Annulus Above 29 mm Maximum Design Coverage
mechanisms.explanation: The largest size in the design (nominal 29 mm) has a maximum annulus limit of 29 mm. A group of 21 no-fit hearts fail the annulus-coverage rule because their annulus exceeds 29 mm (15 no-fit hearts in the 28-30 mm band and 6 no-fit hearts in the 30-32 mm band). Profiling these 21 hearts shows overall large root and outflow dimensions: mean annulusMm is 29.6374773812037 mm (vs 24.3547191099352 mm for the rest, effectSize 2.13597949584241), mean lvotMm is 30.9020908031407 mm (vs 23.8344865826108 mm, effectSize 2.10236204452229), mean sinusMm is 38.4172684392756 mm (vs 32.5181438861868 mm, effectSize 1.77156013501851), mean sinotubularJunctionMm is 33.8359729358574 mm (vs 29.3304848693535 mm, effectSize 1.55588648874686), and mean aorticValveArea is 93.9740706887057 (vs 62.4814642343813). For instance, heart-035 has an annulusMm of 30.0879382259317 mm, failing the 29 mm upper limit by a margin of -1.0879382259317 mm.

Fifty-eight (58) hearts are placed at risk by the stj-excess rule across all three valve sizes (25, 27, and 29). Inspection of individual hearts reveals that each nominal valve size requires a minimum sinotubularJunctionMm clearance equal to nominalMm + 2 mm (27 mm for size 25 as in heart-086, 29 mm for size 27 as in heart-014, and 31 mm for size 29 as in heart-019). The 58 hearts failing this rule have a high lvotOverAnnulusAreaRatio (mean 1.05467950237571 vs 0.947275650077033 in the rest, effectSize 1.00204128599516), larger lvotMm (mean 26.3847049733156 mm vs 23.8359691029916 mm, effectSize 0.75815868971789), and larger annulusMm (mean 25.6775151996809 mm vs 24.4547651640036 mm, effectSize 0.494394948743373), which assigns them to a large valve size, but they simultaneously have a narrower sinotubularJunctionMm (mean 27.9349152860885 mm vs 29.8438131887276 mm, effectSize -0.659202379692027). For example, heart-014 (assigned size 27) has annulusMm 25.8633543516862 mm and lvotOverAnnulusAreaRatio 1.06353176632108, but sinotubularJunctionMm is 26.8311463740637 mm against the limit of 29 mm (margin -2.16885362593629 mm).
mechanisms.title: STJ Excess Risk from Narrow Sinotubular Junction Relative to Outflow/Annulus Size
Sinus Clearance Risk from Small Sinus Width and Height Relative to Outflow/Annulus Size
mechanisms.explanation: Thirty-four (34) hearts are placed at risk by the sinus-clearance rule across sizes 25, 27, and 29 (24 of these also fail stj-excess, while 10 fail sinus-clearance alone, totaling 68 risk hearts). Individual heart inspections show that each nominal valve size requires a minimum sinusMm equal to nominalMm + 5 mm (30 mm for size 25 as in heart-086, 32 mm for size 27 as in heart-014, and 34 mm for size 29 as in heart-019). Profiling the 34 hearts shows they have an elevated lvotOverAnnulusAreaRatio (mean 1.06399826897516 vs 0.953452847866068 in the rest, effectSize 1.03135105080766) and larger lvotMm (mean 26.2666071542428 mm vs 24.014070159648 mm, effectSize 0.670050010378668), coupled with shorter sinusHeightMm (mean 22.9558823529412 mm vs 25.3784153005464 mm, effectSize -0.726747370708025) and narrower sinusMm (mean 30.908178200822 mm vs 33.0061778996219 mm, effectSize -0.630048170067663). For instance, heart-086 (assigned size 25, annulusMm 23.5075668607675 mm) has a sinusMm of 28.6100927234801 mm and sinusHeightMm of 20.5 mm, failing the 30 mm sinus-clearance limit by a margin of -1.38990727651987 mm.
